summary: You can delete admin accounts from the Administrator accounts list, and refused deletions now tell you what to do.

new.title: Delete account button for admins
new.text: The Administrator accounts list now has a Delete account button.

fixes.title: Clear answer when group deletion is off
fixes.text: Deleting a group while group deletion is switched off is now refused and tells you what to do. Before, the change was committed and nothing happened.

fixes.title: Clear answer for on-premises AD admins
fixes.text: Delete account on an on-premises AD admin now says at once that PIM Manager does not delete AD accounts, and what to do instead.
